items.text: Rams WR Puka Nacua left Thursday practice early with a calf injury and was listed as limited; severity TBD pending Friday update from McVay. Already without Davante Adams (hamstring, 6-10 weeks).
items.why: Left practice early; listed limited on report.
items.implication: Risk of missing or limited vs LV; elevates secondary Rams pass-catchers/TEs/RBs if out.
items.opportunity: With Adams already out, Nacua target monopoly at risk; monitor Friday status.

items.text: Commanders WR Terry McLaurin out for season with torn patellar tendon requiring surgery after MNF injury vs SF.
items.why: Torn patellar tendon confirmed; surgery needed.
items.implication: Major target vacuum in WAS offense; boosts remaining WRs/TE and Daniels volume.
items.opportunity: Deebo Samuel and others expand roles ROS.

items.text: Saquon Barkley is back/in line to play Week 7 vs DAL (Berry RB15); efficient in prior full games, strong RB matchup.
items.why: Expected to practice and play Monday night.
items.implication: RB1/2 value returns; Dallas favorable for RBs.

items.text: Chiefs WR Rashee Rice officially DNP for second straight day (hamstring/knee); strong indicator he misses Week 7 at SEA.
items.why: Second consecutive DNP post-bye after missing Week 6.
items.implication: Likely OUT; Xavier Worthy continues elevated WR1 usage.
items.opportunity: Worthy/Kelce/others see full target share vs SEA.

items.text: Jets RB Breece Hall back to practice Thursday per team injury report.
items.why: Returned to practice after prior absence.
items.implication: Positive step toward availability vs MIA; monitor designation.

items.text: Seahawks activated RB Zach Charbonnet from PUP (significant); Arroyo to IR season-ending shoulder. Possibility of some role vs KC (vs former teammate Walker).
items.implication: SEA backfield competition/possible committee; monitor snaps if plays.

items.text: Josh Jacobs allowed facility access for meetings/lifting/medical (non-football); MarShawn Lloyd 49th and Kaleb Johnson 53rd in EPA/rush among qualifiers—both poor, OL messy. Discussed Jacobs ROS outlook.
items.why: Facility access positive signal post-arrest; backups inefficient.
items.implication: Jacobs long-term role secure once back; fade Lloyd/Johnson in interim.
items.opportunity: Handcuff value low given poor EPA.

items.text: LOVE A.J. Brown @ CHI (WR10): Bears good yardage spot; Brown back in real role.
LOVE DeVonta Smith vs DAL (WR11): Elite volume in favorable spot.
LOVE Tucker Kraft @ DET (TE6), Jaylen Warren @ NO (RB9), Chuba Hubbard vs TB (RB10), Bucky Irving @ CAR (RB12): big workloads/friendly matchups; Lions/others soft vs pass/run.
HATE Rome Odunze vs NE, Josh Downs @ MIN, Travis Kelce @ SEA, Josh Jacobs @ DET, Cam Skattebo @ HOU: nasty matchups, role/workload questions, or brutal spots.
Pat Thorman Week 7 rankings live; Week 7 waiver analysis (FAAB/drops/injury/streamers) and ROS Top-150 updated with injuries/roles.
Week 7 Snaps & Pace free: TB@CAR up in pace (both pushing tempo/PROE); MIA@NYJ slow slog (lowest volume); GB@DET and LAR@LV high-volume favorites.
items.implication: Prioritize high-pace games for volume; avoid slogs.
items.opportunity: Elevated play volume in TB/CAR, GB/DET, LAR/LV.

items.text: Yards per target to Justin Jefferson: McCarthy at 5.7 vs prior QBs 9.9-10.8. Tough sample but hard to ignore with McCarthy starting vs HOU.
items.why: Low YPT with McCarthy in limited sample.
items.implication: Jefferson efficiency risk while McCarthy starts; scheme/coach differences noted.
items.opportunity: Monitor for improvement or volume compensation.
